pillars.name: Same Behavior, Different Reasons
pillars.best_format: Reel-first (R01, R08 pattern mode) ~55%; carousels C01, C08 ~45%
pillars.job: Stop the scroll with a behavior everyone recognizes (saying yes, overthinking, doing it all yourself), then show that the reason behind it differs per person. This is the brand's signature idea and the honest curiosity gap: which reason is yours depends on your answers.

pillars.name: Which Line Is Yours? (the questionnaire as content)
pillars.job: Publish the real quiz questions and options (founder-written, already in both languages) as interactive mirrors. Comments with a number are the cheapest engagement there is, and every post doubles as proof that the product is specific, not a horoscope.

pillars.name: The Crystal Shortcut
pillars.job: Turn the Crystal Library's 'what people misunderstand' and 'when it may not be what you need' sections into myth-flips: the same wish (love, protection, abundance, calm) can come from opposite places. Wins the crystal audience without a single efficacy claim and leads to 'the person first, the stone second'.
sources: shared/crystals/*.ts misunderstood + fit + facts + perspective sections

pillars.name: Seven Centers, Read Gently
pillars.job: Teach the seven centers through the founder's approved lessons (outgrow vs. awareness, one image per center). Positions MCC as thoughtful and premium, not woo, and sets up 'you know the seven centers, but what about yours?'.

pillars.name: Inside a Reading
pillars.audience: Warm viewers from all four segments
pillars.job: Answer 'what do I actually get?' with zero reviews: the illustrative Lina pages, the email arriving, Lite vs Full, pay-at-the-end, and the founder saying plainly that MCC just launched. Proof of product replaces social proof.

pillars.name: Giving, Receiving & the Abundance Pattern
pillars.audience: Pattern explorer + the money angle (Full buyers)
pillars.job: The receiving question (compliments, help, the bill) is universal and lands strongly in Gulf hospitality culture; it bridges to the Abundance Pattern loop (need, belief, feeling, response, result), the strongest Full-only chapter. Always 'not a prediction of your financial future'.

reasons: Fears disappointing someone they love.
Doubts their right to make a different choice.
Worries what might happen if they lose control of the situation.
reasons_ar: أحدهم يخشى أن يخذل شخصًا يحبّه.
وآخر يشكّ في حقّه في اتخاذ خيار مختلف.
وثالث يقلق مما قد يحدث إن فقد السيطرة على الموقف.

reasons: It feels easier than explaining it to someone else.
If they're not the one holding it together, things seem to go wrong.
Asking for help feels like owing something back.
reasons_ar: لأن شرح الأمر لشخص آخر يبدو أصعب من إنجازه.
لأن الأمور تبدو وكأنها ستنهار إن لم يُمسك بها بنفسه.
لأن طلب المساعدة يبدو كدَين ينتظر السداد.

reasons: Afraid of choosing wrong and living with it.
Not yet sure what they actually want.
Trusts everyone's opinion more than their own knowing.
reasons_ar: الخوف من الاختيار الخاطئ ومن العيش معه.
عدم الوضوح بعد حول ما يريده فعلًا.
الثقة بآراء الجميع أكثر من المعرفة الداخلية.

behaviors.behavior: Pulling back when things start going well
reasons: Waiting for what hurt before to happen again.
Not feeling they've done enough to deserve it yet.
Success means being seen, and being seen feels exposed.
reasons_ar: انتظار أن يتكرر ما جرح من قبل.
الشعور بعدم الاستحقاق بعد.
النجاح يعني الظهور، والظهور يبدو انكشافًا.

reasons: Silence feels safer than conflict.
Doesn't want to be a burden.
Hasn't had a quiet moment to know what they actually feel.
reasons_ar: الصمت يبدو أكثر أمانًا من الخلاف.
عدم الرغبة في أن يكون عبئًا على أحد.
لم تتح لحظة هدوء بعد لمعرفة الشعور الحقيقي.

reasons: Feels an instant need to give something back.
Wonders what the other person wants in return.
Receiving simply feels unfamiliar.
reasons_ar: الشعور الفوري بضرورة ردّ الجميل.
التساؤل عمّا يريده الطرف الآخر في المقابل.
لأن التلقّي ببساطة غير مألوف.

reasons: Believes that if they stop, everything falls apart.
Feels they have to be useful for people to keep choosing them.
Quiet makes room for feelings they'd rather not meet yet.
reasons_ar: الاعتقاد بأن كل شيء سينهار عند التوقف.
الشعور بضرورة تقديم الفائدة ليبقى الناس متمسكين به.
الهدوء يفتح بابًا لمشاعر لم يحن وقت لقائها بعد.

centers.notice_en: It's hard to relax until everything feels certain.
centers.notice_ar: صعب الاسترخاء قبل أن يصبح كل شيء مضمونًا.
centers.lesson_en: Finding safety within yourself, even when you can't guarantee what happens around you.
centers.lesson_ar: الأمان يمكن أن يُوجد في الداخل، حتى حين لا يمكن ضمان ما يحدث في الخارج.
centers.image: A tree doesn't stand firm because the wind is still, but because its roots run deep.
centers.image_ar: الشجرة لا تثبت لأن الريح ساكنة، بل لأن جذورها عميقة.
centers.broll: tree in wind, roots in soil

centers.notice_en: Joy feels like a reward you earn after the list is done.
centers.notice_ar: الفرح يبدو مكافأة لا تأتي إلا بعد إنهاء القائمة.
centers.lesson_en: Living life as an experience to be felt, not a list of duties waiting to be done.
centers.lesson_ar: الحياة تجربة تُحَسّ ويُستمتع بها، لا قائمة واجبات تنتظر الإنجاز.
centers.image: Still water stagnates; flowing water renews itself.
centers.image_ar: الماء الراكد يأسن، والماء الجاري يتجدّد.

centers.notice_en: A mistake can feel like proof about you, not information.
centers.notice_ar: الخطأ يبدو دليلًا على الذات، لا معلومة نتعلّم منها.
centers.lesson_en: Your power comes from choosing and acting with awareness, not from controlling outcomes.
centers.lesson_ar: القوة تأتي من الاختيار والتصرّف بوعي، لا من السيطرة على النتائج.
centers.image: The sun doesn't force anything to grow. It gives it light.
centers.image_ar: الشمس لا تُجبر شيئًا على النمو، لكنها تمنحه الضوء.

centers.notice_en: Giving is easy. Receiving feels unfamiliar.
centers.notice_ar: العطاء سهل، أما التلقّي فغير مألوف.
centers.lesson_ar: القيمة الذاتية لا تحتاج إلى إثبات.
centers.image: The heart is like the breath: it lives by taking in and giving out together.
centers.image_ar: القلب كالنَّفَس: يعيش بالأخذ والعطاء معًا.
centers.broll: slow breath visualised as light expanding and contracting

centers.notice_en: You say the easy thing, then feel heavy later.
centers.notice_ar: قول الإجابة الأسهل، ثم الشعور بالثقل لاحقًا.
centers.lesson_en: Honest expression doesn't threaten your belonging.
centers.lesson_ar: التعبير الصادق لا يهدّد الانتماء ولا محبة من حولنا.
centers.image: An honest word in its place is stronger than many words spoken to please.
centers.image_ar: كلمة صادقة في مكانها أقوى من كلمات كثيرة تُقال للإرضاء.
centers.broll: a single ripple spreading across dark water

centers.notice_en: You go in circles, doubting whichever way you lean.
centers.notice_ar: الدوران في حلقات، والشك في أي اتجاه نميل إليه.
centers.lesson_en: Listening to intuition alongside reason, so neither hides the other.
centers.lesson_ar: الإصغاء إلى الحدس إلى جانب العقل، فلا يحجب أحدهما الآخر.
centers.image: Only still water reflects the image clearly.
centers.image_ar: وحده الماء الساكن يعكس الصورة بوضوح.
centers.broll: moon reflected in perfectly still water

centers.notice_en: Some parts of life feel right. Others don't fit anymore.
centers.notice_ar: بعض جوانب الحياة تبدو صحيحة، وأخرى لم تعد تناسب.
centers.lesson_en: Your life's value isn't limited to your roles and achievements.
centers.lesson_ar: قيمة الحياة لا تقتصر على الأدوار والإنجازات.
centers.image: A Crown in balance rests on a firm Root: fully on the earth, fully connected to the sky.
centers.image_ar: التاج المتوازن يرتكز على جذر ثابت: حضور كامل على الأرض، واتصال كامل بالسماء.
centers.broll: night sky over a still desert horizon

seed_en: You're always taking care of something or someone; by the time you notice what you need, you're already empty.
You can accept help only when you feel you've done enough to deserve it.
patterns.steady_en: I can stay open without losing myself.
patterns.steady_ar: يمكنني إبقاء قلبي مفتوحًا دون أن أفقد ذاتي.

seed_en: When someone asks what you want, you freeze a little, say the easy thing, then feel heavy later.
You try to say it without really saying it.
patterns.steady_en: I say it clearly, and I can stay steady while I do.
patterns.steady_ar: أقوله بوضوح، وأبقى ثابتًا وأنا أقوله.

seed_en: Your mind keeps running, even when you're trying to rest.
You go in circles and keep doubting whichever way you lean.
patterns.steady_en: I give myself a moment, then I usually know what feels right.
patterns.steady_ar: أمنح نفسي لحظة، ثم أعرف عادةً ما هو الصواب.

seed_en: You can't relax until everything is handled.
It feels easier to do it yourself than to explain it to someone else.
patterns.steady_en: I trust the answer when it comes. I don't need to fight myself for it.
patterns.steady_ar: أثق في الإجابة عندما تظهر، ولست بحاجة إلى محاربة نفسي من أجلها.

seed_en: Right when things start going well, you pull back or make it harder than it needs to be.
A quiet thought: 'I'm going to ruin this right before it works.'
patterns.steady_en: The past still exists, but it doesn't run the whole room anymore.
patterns.steady_ar: الماضي لا يزال موجودًا، لكنه لم يعد يسيطر على المشهد.

seed_en: You have ideas you care about, but something stops you when it's time to finish or share them.
patterns.steady_en: When something wants to be made, I usually follow it.
patterns.steady_ar: عندما يكون هناك شيء يريد أن يتجسّد، أتبعه عادةً.

seed_en: You have people around you, but letting someone close feels more tiring than handling it yourself.
patterns.steady_en: I can be honest, even when it's tender.
patterns.steady_ar: يمكنني التعبير بصدق، حتى في اللحظات الحساسة.
